title: 高盛Ian Draiden：大型科技发行潮，香港市场流动性够用吗？
speaker: Ian Draiden

segments.en: Is liquidity an issue? I mean we were talking about how predominantly a lot of these companies are tech. Um and they only make up what 10% of the stocks really in Hong Kong in particular. Do you think the market act can actually absorb these sort of mega listings?
segments.zh: 流动性是个问题吗？我们谈到这些公司主要是科技类，而且它们在香港市场只占约10%。你认为市场真的能吸收这些大型发行吗？

segments.en: For now for sure. I think if we look at activity in China so far this year. Yes, we've we're seeing elevated levels, but there's nothing. Certainly based on our conversations at Goldman Sachs with our clients with prospective issuers.
segments.zh: 目前肯定没问题。看看今年中国市场的活动，确实水平较高，但没有任何迹象。根据高盛与客户和潜在发行人的交流。

segments.en: There's nothing to suggest right now that there will be an abayance in activity. Of course the environment is becoming a little bit choppy. Okay, so we've seen rates rises in the US. Knock on into Japan. We see currency volatility. We see commodity volatility.
segments.zh: 目前没有任何迹象表明活动会减少。当然环境变得有些波动。美国利率上升，传导到日本。我们看到汇率波动、大宗商品波动。

segments.en: But you know, this was never going to be a linear progression. I think the direction of travel is clearly to the top right. But there are going to be road bumps along the way for sure.
segments.zh: 但这从来不会是一条直线。我认为方向显然是向右上方的，但过程中肯定会有颠簸。
